notes: Curated historically documented sources; verify current patch, eligibility and difficulty at linked references. Not Blizzard API acquisition data.

items.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
items.source: Quest chain begun by Bindings of the Windseeker from Garr and Baron Geddon; collect quest materials and complete Rise, Thunderfury!
steps: Acquire one Binding of the Windseeker from Garr or Baron Geddon in Molten Core
Acquire the second Binding of the Windseeker
Continue Highlord Demitrian's quest chain in Silithus
Collect required Firelord essence and Elementium materials
Complete the Thunderaan encounter and turn in Rise, Thunderfury!

items.name: Invincible's Reins
steps: Enter Icecrown Citadel and select the applicable 25-player Heroic raid difficulty
Defeat the Lich King for a chance at Invincible's Reins
Track each completed attempt manually and review lockout eligibility in game

items.name: Ashes of Al'ar
steps: Travel to The Eye in Tempest Keep
Defeat Kael'thas Sunstrider for a chance to obtain Ashes of Al'ar
Log your attempts manually; verify current lockout rules in game

items.name: Shadowmourne
items.source: Ashen Verdict quest chain beginning with The Sacred and the Corrupt
steps: Meet the Ashen Verdict requirements and begin the Shadowmourne quest chain
Collect Light's Vengeance, Primordial Saronite and the specified boss reagents
Complete soul and infusion objectives with Shadow's Edge
Collect Shadowfrost Shards and finish the quest chain
